descriptorHelp.heavyAtoms: Non-hydrogen atom count: a rough measure of molecular size.
descriptorHelp.rings: Total ring count (SSSR). Rigid ring systems limit conformational freedom.
descriptorHelp.aromaticRings: Aromatic rings are flat, stack with proteins and DNA, and absorb UV.
descriptorHelp.hbd: Hydrogen-bond donors (O–H, N–H). Many donors mean high water solubility and poor membrane crossing.
descriptorHelp.hba: Hydrogen-bond acceptors (N, O). Lipinski's rule of five uses ≤10 as a drug-likeness cutoff.
descriptorHelp.rotatableBonds: Flexibility. Rigid molecules (few rotatable bonds) bind more selectively; long chains are floppy.
descriptorHelp.logP: Crippen octanol/water partition estimate, computed by RDKit from the structure (not a measured logP).
descriptorHelp.tpsa: Topological polar surface area (Å²), computed from the structure.
descriptorHelp.fsp3: Fraction of sp³ carbons. Flat aromatic molecules have low Fsp³; 3D-shaped natural products have high Fsp³.
descriptorHelp.stereocenters: Number of defined stereocentres in the SMILES.
